What he did not see was the Imperial Army's reflection. They must have reached the straits by now,\"}","{\"text\": \"barring any mishaps in the forest. Tall feather-thin lake trees blocked much of his view of the straits, but an army, particularly one clan in slow-moving heavy armor could not move invisibly, silently. \\\"Let me see the map again,\\\" he called to his\"}","{\"text\": \"captain. \\\"Is there no other way they could approach?\\\" \\\"We have sentries posted in the swamps to the north in case they're fool enough to go there and be bogged under,\\\" said the captain. \\\"We would at least hear about it. But there is no other way across\"}","{\"text\": \"the lake except through the straits.\\\" Vivec looked down again at his reflection, which seemed to be distorting his image, mocking him. Across the lake, though it was but a\"}","{\"text\": \"small shadow on the horizon, they could see gouts of flame from the assault on Ald Marak.
